checks.details: Only territory exploration was produced; the six final visual assets were intentionally deferred pending client selection.
10 hypotheses are present, within the requested range of 8–12.
Three territories are defined with distinct hero claims and visual grammars: mobility, controlled splash context, and morning-to-evening time progression.
All numeric/specification claims are limited to 12 小时续航, IPX4 防泼水, and 一体式挂环.
The selection board references the supplied product master directly and applies placement/scale only; no product pixels or structure were edited.
The concepts explicitly prohibit immersion, strong water jets, heavy-rain drenching, and waterproof wording.

The board was rendered to a 1600 × 2200 PNG and visually inspected at original resolution. The header, 3 territory columns, all 10 scene cards, tradeoffs, selection checkpoint, and product thumbnail are present without clipping. The thumbnail uses a direct scaled copy of the supplied master.
